name: bento
label: Bento
css: .style-bento { background: var(--surface, #FFF5E6); width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: stretch; padding: 32px; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .style-bento::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #FAD4C0) 0%, transparent 40%); opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; } .style-bento .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text, #111827); letter-spacing: -0.02em; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .style-bento .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; padding: 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 85%; } .style-bento .step { font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; position: absolute; top: -20px; right: -20px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; z-index: 0; } .style-bento .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #111827); position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .slide-code.style-bento { background: var(--code-bg, #1a1a1a); } .slide-code.style-bento .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #FAD4C0); } .slide-code.style-bento .text { color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-bento .step { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .slide-code.style-bento .brand { color: #b0b0b0; } .slide-code.style-bento::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #FAD4C0) 0%, transparent 40%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-bento { background: var(--insight-bg, #0f172a); } .slide-insight.style-bento .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #FAD4C0); } .slide-insight.style-bento .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: -0.01em; z-index: 1; margin: 24px 0 0 0; padding: 0; max-width: 90%; } .slide-insight.style-bento .text { color: #d0d0d0; } .slide-insight.style-bento .step { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .slide-insight.style-bento .brand { color: #a0a0a0; } .slide-insight.style-bento::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #FAD4C0) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.15; }
